story: A low vital capacity at screening and the PI's decision, linked at the next question

messages.text: 1001-146 screening SVC came out at 46% of predicted.
PI reviewed 1001-146's SVC of 46% and decided she is a screen failure; she was not randomized.
1001-146 wants to re-screen next month. What was her vital capacity last time and what is the cut-off?
